    drone Exterior Cleaning Services

    VSI Aerial provides exterior cleaning services for any property cleaning project. Our experienced team specializes in commercial & residential exterior cleaning for windows facades, roofs, solar panels and gutters.

    Contact Us
    Play Video

    Exterior Window Cleaning

    Commercial

    Rain, pollen, bird droppings, and pollution streak commercial building glass fast - and traditional lift or rope-access cleaning is expensive, slow, and creates real risk for cleaning crews. VSI Aerial's window cleaning drones use a touch-free, chemical-and-deionized-water process to clean vertical glass on office buildings, apartment complexes, hotels, and high-rises at a fraction of the time and cost.

     

    ​

    ​

    Residential

    ​Hard water, pollen, and everyday grime build up fast on home windows. Most traditional cleaners rely on ladders that can scratch frames, break seals, or create safety hazards on multi-story homes. Our drones deliver a spot-free, touch-free clean for single-story and multi-story homes without anyone ever climbing to your roofline.

    Building Window Cleaning
    House Window Cleaning
    Window Cleaning

    Facade Cleaning

    Commercial

    Organic growth, pollution, and environmental buildup make commercial facades look neglected and accelerate material deterioration. Scaffolding and lifts take days to mobilize and add serious insurance exposure for property managers. VSI's drones clean commercial facades top to bottom without scaffolding.

     

    ​

    ​

    Residential

    ​Siding, stucco, and brick collect mold, algae, and pollen that standard pressure washing can miss - or damage. Our soft-wash drone process is safe for all residential exterior materials and reaches elevated surfaces a traditional pressure washer can't, all from ground level with no crew on ladders.

    Building Facade Cleaning
    House Facade Cleaning
    Facade Cleaning

    Roof Cleaning

    Commercial

    Algae, dirt, and debris on commercial roofs shorten their lifespan and can void manufacturer warranties if cleaned incorrectly. VSI's soft-wash drone system handles flat roofs, sloped roofs, and fragile roofing materials without putting a single crew member on the surface - fast mobilization, no liability exposure

     

    ​

    ​

    Residential

    ​Moss, lichen, and algae don't just look bad - they cause shingle damage that cuts years off your roof's life. VSI's drones soft-wash residential roofs at low pressure to remove organic growth without voiding your warranty or putting anyone on a steep, slippery surface.

    Building Roof Cleaning
    House Roof Cleaning
    Roof Cleaning

    Solar Panel Cleaning

    Commercial

    Dust, pollen, and bird droppings on commercial solar arrays can reduce energy output by up to 25%, directly cutting ROI. VSI uses a solar-panel-safe cleaning solution and pure deionized water rinse to restore panel efficiency - including pre and post visual inspections.​

    ​

    ​

    ​

    Residential

    ​Dirty panels mean lower output and higher energy bills, but most residential cleaning services require roof access that puts people at risk and can scratch panel surfaces. VSI's touch-free drone process uses a solar-safe solution and deionized rinse to restore panel output without anyone setting foot on your roof.

    Building Solar Panel Cleaning
    House Solar Panel Cleaning
    Solar Panel Cleaning

    Gutter Cleaning

    Clogged gutters lead to water damage, fascia rot, and foundation issues - and clearing them traditionally means sending someone up a ladder, which is the leading cause of home maintenance injuries. VSI Aerial uses drone technology to inspect and clean gutters on homes of any height, safely and efficiently from ground level.

     

    Drone gutter cleaning is part of our full residential house cleaning offering. Whether you need a one-time clear-out before storm season or a recurring maintenance plan, VSI handles it without anyone climbing your home.
